createdBy: external-review:care2talk-9e (two independent seat reports; code-verified in this session)
impact: Every git capture in src/utils/git.ts calls execAsync with no cwd option, so `git diff --cached` / `git diff HEAD` run in whatever directory the client spawned the stdio server in. None of the MCP tools (review_code auto_diff, review_precommit) accept a cwd/repo path, and a stdio server has no way to learn the caller's current directory. A session that later moves into a git worktree (e.g. `.claude/worktrees/<name>`) therefore captures the main checkout's index: review_precommit returns ready_to_commit with warning "No staged changes found" while a full staged diff exists in the worktree, and review_code auto_diff reports "No changes found to review". Reported independently by two external seats hours apart (care2talk-39 in ~/Developer/ReactNative, c2t-design-71 in a c2t-design worktree); each burned a review call and a from-scratch diagnosis. Affects both codex-bridge and codex-bridge-local. Workaround: pass the diff explicitly. Fix direction: accept an optional `cwd` (or `repo_path`) tool parameter validated as an existing directory inside a git work tree, thread it through resolve-diff/git helpers as execAsync's cwd, and have the CLI default it to process.cwd(). See ISS-028 for the cheaper first step of naming the capture directory in the result.
resolution:
Fixed in 0a777fd on branch feat/request-cwd (stacked on fix/capture-dir-disclosure -> feat/astra-tiers -> feat/model-metadata -> main).

CONTRACT. Optional `cwd` on MCP review_plan/review_code/review_precommit: absolute, non-empty, control-char-free, <=4096 code units, no `~` expansion, canonicalized with realpath and REVALIDATED after canonicalization. `--cwd <path>` on all three CLI commands, relative resolved against one captured invocation directory, and it does NOT rebase --plan/--diff/--config. Omission uses a launch directory captured and canonicalized once at startup. Per call only — never persisted as session state or history, so callers repeat it on resume. Missing paths, broken symlinks, files, and unreadable directories return one sanitized INVALID_INPUT that echoes no path.

ARCHITECTURE. New ReviewExecutionContext { workingDirectory, copilotInstructions? } is REQUIRED on plan/code/precommit/cross-review backend inputs; ResolvedWorkspace { workingDirectory, repositoryRoot, repositoryError? } stays at the acquisition boundary. TurnParams.workingDirectory is required and carried through initial turns, every chunk, resumes, parse retries, XProtect recovery retries, failover, second-provider fresh reviews, and deep cross-review — src/backends/cwd-propagation.test.ts asserts each of those paths and that the value is never process.cwd(). Internal inputs are built as explicit literals; raw MCP/CLI arguments are never spread across a backend boundary.

FLOW. validate -> bounded preparation permit -> canonicalize + discover -> capture -> load instructions only when a provider call will happen -> release permit -> lifecycle admission -> execute. Preparation failures reach neither a session nor a provider. The limiter is server-scoped, separate from session admission, at most 4 concurrent, REVIEW_BUSY on excess with no queue, released in a finally on every exit path including synthetic returns and throws, and never held during a provider call. It is also bounded in TIME (60s): an uncancellable fs call on a dead mount would otherwise pin a permit forever, and four of those would wedge the server permanently.

GIT. execFile with an argument array, explicit cwd, and a sanitized environment. Capture is anchored at repositoryRoot. Pagers, color, external diff, textconv and fsmonitor are off; diff prefixes are PINNED (diff.noprefix/mnemonicPrefix/srcPrefix/dstPrefix) so a caller-named repository cannot change how its own diff parses. HEAD is classified by EXIT CODE — resolved / unborn only when HEAD is a valid symbolic ref whose target is absent / GIT_ERROR for detached-unresolvable, damaged, or inconsistent. The single remaining message-based check (is-inside-work-tree) is made reliable by pinning LC_ALL/LANG/LANGUAGE=C. maxBuffer overflow is reported as an overflow rather than a timeout. Ref validation, staged/working behavior, the 10 MiB buffer, the 30s timeout, and the exclusion of untracked files are preserved. A git discovery FAILURE no longer fails reviews that need no git: it is carried on the workspace and surfaced as GIT_ERROR by the capture path, while a plain directory still returns INVALID_INPUT.

ENVIRONMENT. One string-only snapshot at module load, stripped case-insensitively of the repository-selecting vars, the indexed GIT_CONFIG_(KEY|VALUE)_<n> pattern, the config-injecting GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM (which can introduce a filter.<driver>.clean command that --no-ext-diff does NOT disable), and the discovery vars GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES/GIT_DISCOVERY_ACROSS_FILESYSTEM/GIT_NAMESPACE. PATH and credentials are preserved. A fresh copy is handed to each consumer because the Codex SDK mutates the object it receives — including the XProtect-recovery client. process.env is never mutated and process.chdir is never called.

INSTRUCTIONS. Request-scoped, anchored at repositoryRoot (worktree-aware) else workingDirectory, read asynchronously, coalesced per root while in flight with the entry dropped after settlement so an edit lands on the next review. Bounds: 1 repo-wide file + at most 64 scoped, 64 KiB per file, 256 KiB aggregate, sanitized INVALID_INPUT on violation, warn-and-continue preserved for ordinary read failures. Files are TYPE-CHECKED before opening, so a FIFO cannot block a read that holds a permit. Results are frozen and the scoped array is readonly, since concurrent requests share one object.

ISS-028 PRESERVED. captured_from is still the exact directory handed to git — now the resolved repository root rather than the server's own directory — omitted for explicit diffs even when discovery ran, excluded from model-facing schemas, and absent from history.

VERIFICATION. 1197 tests across 51 files pass; typecheck, eslint, prettier (on every touched file), build, and `git diff --check` clean. An 8-lens adversarial review (33 agents) produced 26 findings; 8 survived two-verifier adjudication. Five were fixed here: the permit time bound and the blocking-open that caused it, unpinned diff prefixes, and the two vacuous MCP cwd tests. Two are explicit plan boundaries left alone (clean/process filters still execute; agy serialization stays process-global). Its completeness audit added four more fixes: GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL/SYSTEM, the three discovery variables, the locale-dependent no-repository check, and the missing agy env/PWD assertions. Test quality was verified by MUTATION rather than by reading: dropping the caller's cwd, deleting the agy env, and defaulting the requested directory each now fail the suite, and 15 conditional `kind === 'ready'` guards were hardened so a reverted feature can no longer skip assertions silently. Coverage includes a real linked-worktree probe with providers mocked, real FIFO tests, and five MCP integration regressions (capture/instructions in B while the provider stays in the named subdirectory; captured_from is B and omission defaults to A; explicit diffs omit it; interleaved A/B requests with a retry each keeping its own diff, instructions, directory and session; invalid input reaching neither admission nor provider).

Out of scope and unchanged: config reloads, database relocation (filed as ISS-035), version bump, publication.
title: Git auto-capture runs in the MCP server's spawn cwd, not the caller's worktree; worktree sessions get a false "No staged changes found"
